text:
Nico: whos up for a last-minute couch co-op tonight? thinking mezz, 8pm setup, 8:30 start. Mario + a squad of indie co-op picks. low-key. :video_game:
Sam: im in. can bring Switch + dock. also 2 pro controllers. :thumbsup:
Jules: i can bring an ethernet cable and my old xbox pad. wifi was jittery last time.
Aria: bringing snacks (salsa + chips) and a blanket. vegetarian friendly. :chipmunk:
Nico: perfect. need one more player to make a cozy 4. @Jules can you also bring an HDMI adapter? last projector wants USB-C.
Jules: yep USB-C->HDMI in my bag. leaving it on the mezz table at 7:45.
Sam: poll: start 8:30 or 9pm? react :one: 8:30, :two: 9pm
Nico: leaning 8:30
Sam: :one:
Jules: :one: (early bird)
Aria: :two: (need to grab snacks)
Nico: ok 8:30 then. middle ground.
bot-scheduler: event created: "Couch Co-op Night" at 2025-11-02T20:30:00Z.
Sam: heads up: projector remote batteries are sometimes dead. anyone have AAA?
Aria: i have AAA. i'll leave them next to the snacks.
Jules: bringing a small surge protector and a 10ft cat6. also tape to mark the HDMI cable so it doesnt walk off.
Nico: sweet. house rule: no live streams without everyone's consent. local clips ok.
Aria: agreed. also bring headphones if you want quiet voice chat. couch seats 3; folding chairs ok.
Sam: quick setup note: if youre plugging a Switch into the projector, set console to handheld dock first then display settings > TV resolution to 720p if we hit lag.
Jules: noted. will have laptop for local recording if anyone wants highlights (OBS local file only). office blocks outbound streaming ports.
Nico: sign-up: Sam (Switch), Jules (wired pad + cable), Aria (snacks + blanket), Nico (host PC). extras rotate in.
Aria: ill tape a little sticky "controller box" on the handoff tote so controllers dont disappear mid-rotation.
Sam: anyone down for a 20-min warmup Smash free-for-all before the co-op?
Jules: sure, quick warmup sounds fun.
Nico: final ask: please tidy up when you leave, toss wrappers in compost, return controllers to the tote. see you 8:30! :socks:
Aria: see ya! bringing napkins and hand sanitizer. :sparkles:
